triage.action.emergency: Call 911 or go to the nearest Emergency Department immediately. Do NOT wait.

triage.action.self_care: Manage at home with the guidance below. Monitor for worsening.

visual_triage.title: Visual Symptom Assessment
visual_triage.disclaimer: Visual assessment supports CTCAE grading — it does not replace clinician evaluation. All findings require clinical verification.
visual_triage.select_ae.title: What would you like to photograph?
visual_triage.select_ae.subtitle: Select the skin or mouth symptom that best matches what you see.
visual_triage.capture.subtitle: Take or upload a clear, close-up photo
visual_triage.capture.tip1: Take photo in natural daylight or bright indoor light
visual_triage.capture.tip2: Fill the frame with the affected area
visual_triage.capture.tip4: Include a small ruler or coin for scale if possible
visual_triage.capture.tap_to_capture: Tap to take or choose a photo
visual_triage.capture.size_warning: File is too large (max 10 MB). Please choose a smaller image.
visual_triage.processing.title: Analyzing your photo
visual_triage.privacy_note: Your photo was analyzed in memory only. No image data was stored on our servers.

welcome.title: OncoTriage AI
